title: docs(skills): actions teach ai.requiresConfirmation beside confirmText; permission sets teach the owner-only delete floor
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSUuFiSNNxgHbrBe6r4uDVrg)_

Fixes #37762

Clause-②: no (published prose only; teaches the confirmation flag and the delete floor already on main)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：智能体照技能搭建时，AI 可调用的删除类动作会打开 `ai.requiresConfirmation`（以前只写 `confirmText`，那只是点击弹窗文案，不拦 AI 调用）；给私有对象授删除权时会知道默认只能删自己创建的记录，要删全组织的记录需加 `writeScope: 'org'` 或 Modify All。
- 为什么做：objectstack-ai/cloud#5080 逐项拆分里，这两条技能缺口在 9 次 door 搭建中丢了 5 分（中位数各 1 分）。
- 出错会怎样：只改技能文字和两条 eval，不动产品。两个文件原本 token 余量为 0，各删了一处重复说法，剩余按实测抬高天花板（+10、+48）。
- 要你做什么：这是受管的技能文件，需要按受管路径审批后合并。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, `confirmText` bullet (card step 1, line 49 on `8b9b9d23` as the card says): `confirmText` gates no AI call; an `ai.exposed` action also sets `ai.requiresConfirmation: true`.
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, Three axes (card step 2; `allowDelete` is taught here, not in a SKILL.md): `allowDelete` removes only rows the caller created (`owner_only_deletes`). On a `private` object owning the row, `writeScope: 'org'` or `modifyAllRecords` widens it, an `edit` share never; elsewhere only an authored `delete` row policy does.
- Evals: `objectstack-ui` views-apps-actions-pages #26 (AI-exposed delete action), `objectstack-data` hooks-security-seeds-datasources #38 (SDR with `readScope: 'org'` + `allowDelete` gets 403 on an admin-imported contact). The ui evals README line names the new case.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: two rows raised by the measured remainder, each with its arithmetic comment.
- `.changeset/37762-…md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Premise check and deviations

- Card premises re-measured on `origin/main` `8b9b9d23`: the `confirmText` sentence and the absence of any `requiresConfirmation` / owner-only delete line in both skills still hold.
- Deviation from the card's wording of rule 2, read off the code: the floor is `created_by == current_user.id` (`plugin-security/src/platform-ownership-policies.ts`), not "rows the user owns", and it lifts where `SharingService.checkDelete` answers `allow` (owning the row, write depth `org`, or `modifyAllRecords`, on an owner-scoped object). So `writeScope: 'org'` alone widens it; no extra row policy is needed. On a public object the sharing verdict abstains and only an authored `delete` row policy widens it, Modify All included. This matches the scorer's reading in `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts` (`deleteFloorReading`).
- Line budget: `skills/**` prose +2 lines net (card cap +4); eval JSON +24 lines.

| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` | 248 B | 59 B: the "Prefer `member_default`" bullet's `owner_only_deletes` (now taught above), "the built-in", "for the common cases" | 17168 → 17357 | 4340 | 4292 → 4340 (+48) |
